name: Trapped Portcullis
description: Two portcullises drop down to block progress through this area.
disable: DC 33 Thievery (master) to disable the trigger that causes the portcullises to drop
reset: The trap can be manually reset with a 10-minute Manipulate activity performed in the hallways to the east or west of this area, as long as neither portcullis is broken or destroyed.

generalAbilities.name: Drop From Ceiling
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A character enters a square between the two portcullises

Effect Both portcullises drop from the ceiling; attempting to lift one requires a DC 30 Athletics check to Force Open. When the portcullises drop, creatures in adjacent squares must attempt a DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unharmed and can take a Step as a reaction to move to an adjacent square.

Success As critical success, but the creature takes a glancing blow from the falling portcullis for (2d12+15) Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Failure The creature is struck by the falling portcullis for (4d12+30) Bludgeoning Damage damage and is knocked Prone in their square.

Critical Failure The creature is struck by the falling portcullis for (6d12+45) Bludgeoning Damage damage, is knocked prone, and is Immobilized by the portcullis as it pins them to the ground until they can Escape or Force Open the portcullis (DC 30, Athletics).
